# Little Otter Health

> Little Otter Health delivers virtual family mental health care with tailored therapy and support services for all ages, from infants to parents.

Little Otter provides evidence-based telehealth mental health services for families, recently merging with Hazel Health to expand access to 20 million families. The platform serves infants through parents with specialized programs including autism spectrum disorder support, measurement-based care, and partnerships with major health systems and insurers.

## Key Topics

- Family Mental Health Care
- Telehealth/Virtual Therapy
- Behavioral Health Services
- Mental Health Treatment
- Child Psychiatry
- Parent Coaching
- ADHD
- Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
- Postpartum Mental Health
- Insurance Coverage
- Measurement-Based Care
- Family Wellness
- Child Development
- Parenting Support
- Therapy Services

## Family Mental Health Services

- [Little Otter | Mental Health Services for the Whole Family](https://www.littleotterhealth.com): Homepage: Virtual mental health care for families with tailored therapy and support services.
- [Mental Health Services for Children Ages 0 to 2](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/children-0-2): Mental health services for infants and toddlers with parenting support and early childhood care.
- [Mental Health Services for Children Ages 3 to 7](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/children-3-7): Therapy services for young children ages 3-7 addressing anxiety, behavior, and emotional support.
- [Mental Health Services for Children Ages 8 to 12](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/children-8-12): Mental health services for school-age children addressing ADHD, anxiety, and family support.
- [Mental Health Services for Teens | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/teenagers): Teen mental health therapy addressing depression, anxiety, and LGBTQ+ support.
- [Mental Health Services for Parents | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/parents): Mental health services for parents addressing depression, anxiety, and work-life balance.
- [Mental Health Services for Trying, Expecting & Postpartum Parents](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-families/trying-expecting): Prenatal and postpartum mental health support for growing families and fertility treatment.

## Care Model & Assessment

- [Our Family Mental Health Care Model | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/how-care-works/how-care-works): Overview of Little Otter's family mental health care model with whole-family approach.
- [Family Mental Health Check-up | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/how-care-works/fmhc): Free family mental health assessment tool measuring biomarkers and screening needs.
- [Virtual or Online Mental Health Therapy Efficacy | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/how-care-works/why-virtual-care-works): Evidence-based guide on telehealth efficacy and benefits of virtual family mental health care.

## Specialized Programs

- [RAFT Program: Autism Spectrum Disorder | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/raft-program-autism-spectrum-disorder): Comprehensive ASD mental health program with evidence-based therapies and parent support.

## Provider & Partner Solutions

- [Pediatricians & Clinicians | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/pediatricians-clinicians): Provider platform for pediatricians and clinicians offering personalized patient care.
- [Health Plans | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/health-plans): Health plan partnership solutions for mental health care delivery and outcomes measurement.
- [Health Systems | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/health-systems): Virtual care platform solution for health systems providing family mental health services.
- [Partner with Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/strategic-partners): Partnership opportunities with employers, schools, and health tech organizations.
- [Refer to Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/for-providers-and-partners/refer): Provider referral process for connecting families to Little Otter mental health services.

## Pricing & Access

- [Pricing & Insurance](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/pricing-insurance): Pricing, insurance coverage options, and accepted health plans information.

## Resources & Education

- [Resource Hub | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/resources/family-resources): Family resource hub with assessments, toolkits, activity guides, and parenting resources.
- [Blog | Little Otter](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/resources/blog): Blog hub featuring mental health articles, parenting guidance, and family wellness resources.
- [Our Next Chapter: Hazel Health and Little Otter Merge to Transform Care for Millions of Families | Little Otter Health News](https://www.littleotterhealth.com/blog/our-next-chapter-hazel-health-and-little-otter-merge): Little Otter and Hazel Health merger expands family mental health care access to 20M families.
